briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 and DeepSeek R2 escalate frontier race with multimodal breakthroughs

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies as multiple labs release advanced reasoning models amid rising geopolitical scrutiny. Compute shortages persist while safety frameworks lag deployment velocity.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed Orion-2 achieving 87% on GPQA Diamond; Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus follows with agentic coding gains; Meta open-sourced Llama 4.1 405B variant.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins next quarter.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1.2M units; Google TPU v6 clusters online in Iowa; xAI Memphis supercluster hits 300k H100 equivalents.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory fragmentation slow US labs more than Chinese state-backed efforts by Q4 2026?
